assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent character sprite for a 2D skeletal dress-up game, Muse Bloom.
Create ONE original full-body young adult woman (age 20) in a polished contemporary Western cartoon game style, with the rounded dimensional shading and appealing face of a high-quality stylized 3D animated feature. Warm light peach skin, expressive hazel almond eyes, small friendly smile, youthful soft cheekbones. Chestnut brown hair in a simple neat high ponytail with side fringe, hair does NOT extend across shoulders or arms. Fashionable, charming and natural. NOT a baby, not chibi, not anime, no huge doll eyes.
Proportions: about 6 heads tall, normal healthy silhouette, natural waist and hips, moderate length legs. Anatomically believable elbows, wrists, knees, five delicate fingers.
She wears a plain fitted ivory sleeveless crew-neck tank top, fully covers torso to hip, high-waisted fitted dusty rose cycling shorts to upper thigh, and clean ivory low-top sneakers. These are modest neutral fitting clothes, opaque with no logos.
Technical composition: portrait canvas, ideally 1024 by 1536. Perfect front view, orthographic camera, symmetrical relaxed A-pose with both arms angled about 12 degrees outward from vertical, elbows very slightly bent, hands relaxed fingers pointing down and apart from thighs. Legs straight, feet about hip width apart, both face forward. Head upright looks forward. Whole body from top of ponytail to soles fits with 5 percent margin. No perspective or foreshortening. Visible shoulders and elbows unobstructed. Soft warm key light from upper left and subtle cool rim light, nuanced skin shading and fabric folds give rounded volume. Crisp detailed edges.
Actual transparent alpha background. No room, floor, cast shadow, text, border, reference guides, other objects or additional views.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the exact reference for canvas dimensions, body shape, front-view A pose, lighting and silhouette of a young adult game character. Create a production garment overlay texture aligned EXACTLY to this reference.
Output ONLY clothes, on truly transparent alpha background. No person, no skin, no face, no hair, no hands, no legs, no shoes, no mannequin, no shadow or glow. Do not center or rearrange the clothes: keep their exact worn position on the original 1024x1536 canvas.
One coordinated outfit: a soft rose-pink fine-knit fitted crew-neck cardigan, fully buttoned, ribbed cuffs and hem, small pearl buttons and restrained embroidered flower on one chest; long sleeves follow BOTH arms of the reference all the way to the wrists, including their slightly bent elbows. Natural sleeve fullness, shoulders sit at the reference shoulders. Top starts at the base of the neck (around y310), neckline hugs neck, fitted waist, hem at high hip y650. Sleeves angle down and outward to wrists (around x260 and x765, y710). No skin anywhere.
A medium-indigo high-waisted A-line denim skirt, waist matching character around y610, skirt wider than hips, hem at y880, covering the original cycling shorts completely. Realistic seams, soft folds, warm golden stitching and a tiny button, modest youthful casual style. Skirt visually overlaps bottom of cardigan at waist without blank space.
Preserve the reference's polished rounded 3D-cartoon illustrated shading, gentle highlights, fabric texture. Not photographic. Garments are 2D art overlays for a skeletal game.
CRITICAL actual transparent background; all empty areas including neck opening and between sleeves and torso must be fully transparent. No background haze, grid, labels or text. Entire full portrait canvas retained with head and legs areas empty.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image supplies the shape, pose and rendering style of the young adult woman in our dress-up game.
Generate ONLY a coordinated outfit overlay, no person. Soft powder-blue short-sleeve knit polo with a small open collar, ivory trim, subtle cable knit, relaxed but fitted waist, hem reaches high hip. Two short sleeves extend along the reference's outward A-pose upper arms and stop mid upper arm. High-waisted tailored warm ivory wide-leg trousers with subtle pleats, fluid fabric and a narrow brown belt, straight hems at ankle height. Fashionable understated everyday look. All clothes fully opaque.
Exact reference placement, same 1024x1536 portrait canvas: collar around (512,315), shoulders near (397,350) and (628,350), sleeve ends near (361,445) and (664,445), shirt hem at y635, waist x405..620 at y620, hips x367..660 at y770, trouser knees y1020, hems y1355. Garments worn around an INVISIBLE mannequin matching reference body. Head, neck, arms, hands, shoes and backdrop completely absent and transparent. Do not enlarge or reframe garments to fill empty canvas. Keep cloth 3D shading consistent with reference: warm light from upper left, soft rim on right, delicate material detail, high quality Western animated movie style. No logos or text. Actual transparent alpha with no glow or shadow around garments.
